resources.string: This device already has a Mosaic account. Unlock it instead.
This app isn\'t linked to a saved website. Link it in Mosaic first, then try again.
This app isn\'t verified for that website, so Mosaic won\'t use its passkeys. Use the website in a browser instead.
Mosaic couldn\'t check that this app belongs to the website. Check your connection and try again.
Mosaic is still finishing the last step. Wait a moment, then try again.
The master password is empty. Enter it to continue.
This account syncs through a cloud folder, which Mosaic on phones doesn\'t support yet. Use a desktop or a sync server account.
This field belongs to another site embedded in the page, so Mosaic won\'t fill it.
This page isn\'t using a secure connection, so Mosaic won\'t fill it. Open the https version of the page.
Something unexpected stopped this action. Try again, and restart Mosaic if it keeps happening.
Something in this form isn\'t valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
This vault holds one-time codes only.
Mosaic is locked. Unlock it to continue.
There\'s no account on this device yet. Create one, or sign in with your Emergency Kit.
Mosaic has no login for this app or website. Open Mosaic to add one.
This device doesn\'t have enough free memory to unlock your vault. Close other apps and try again.
That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.
This key isn\'t valid. It uses only the letters A to Z and the digits 2 to 7; check for typos.
This setup code uses settings Mosaic doesn\'t support. Enter the setup key instead.
This is a Google Authenticator export code, which Mosaic can\'t read yet. Set up each account again on its site, or enter its setup key.
More than one setup code is visible. Show only the one you want, then try again.
This QR code isn\'t a two-factor setup code. Look for the code on the site\'s 2FA setup page.
This isn\'t a valid otpauth:// link. Copy the whole link again.
You already have a passkey for this account in Mosaic. Sign in with it instead.
Mosaic has no passkey for this website. Sign in another way.
This passkey request has expired. Start again from the app.
This website needs a passkey type Mosaic can\'t create yet. Choose another way to sign in.
Unlocking with the master password isn\'t possible here. Open the Mosaic app and unlock it there.
Enter your master password this time. Quick unlock works again after that.
Mosaic found no QR code in that image. Try again with a sharper picture.
Quick unlock expired. Unlock with your master password, then turn it on again in Settings.
Quick unlock stopped working on this device and was turned off. Unlock with your master password.
This change needs your master password. Enter it to confirm.
The website name in this request isn\'t valid. Cancel and start again.
That isn\'t a Secret Key. Yours starts with “M1-” and is on your Emergency Kit.
That Secret Key has a typo. Compare it with your Emergency Kit, character by character.
This device doesn\'t have your Secret Key. Type it from your Emergency Kit.
That setup code isn\'t valid or has expired. Create a new one on your computer and scan it again.
Mosaic couldn\'t reach the secure storage of this device. Restart your phone and try again.
Mosaic is already open on this computer. Close the other window, then try again.
Mosaic couldn\'t open your vault file on this device. Check that the disk is available and has free space, then restart Mosaic.
Your account\'s keys were renewed on another device. Use the Secret Key from the new Emergency Kit to continue.
Mosaic couldn\'t sync. Check your connection, then try again.
The browser step ran out of time. Start it again.
Sync isn\'t set up on this device yet. Set it up in Settings first.
Your master password was changed on the server or in the folder. Enter the new one below.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
This server runs a version that doesn\'t match your Mosaic. Update Mosaic or ask the server\'s owner to update it.
Mosaic only connects to servers over https, so nobody on the way can read or change your data. Use an https:// address.
This doesn\'t look like a Mosaic server. Check the address; it should look like https://sync.example.com.
This isn\'t the server this account syncs with. Check the address.
Mosaic couldn\'t reach the server. Check the address and your internet connection, then try again.
The server signed this device out. Sign in again to keep syncing. Your changes are safe on this device.
That code isn\'t right or has expired. Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
This sync account needs a code from your authenticator app. Enter the 6-digit code.
This vault can\'t be opened in this session. Unlock it with its hardware key, or sync and try again.
That master password or Secret Key didn\'t work. Check Caps Lock and your keyboard layout, then try again.
Hidden. Choose Reveal to show it.

resources.string: Mosaic stores your Secret Key only on phones that are protected by a passcode. Set a passcode in your device settings, then open Mosaic again.
Turn on Mosaic in the AutoFill settings so it can fill passwords, passkeys and codes in apps and in Safari.
Open Settings, then General, then AutoFill & Passwords, and turn on Mosaic.
Your vault is on this phone and unlocked.
Mosaic checks it on this phone. It is never sent to the server.
Pre-audit software: no outside security review yet.
You find it in your Emergency Kit or in Settings on your computer. Capital letters and dashes do not matter.
Finish the sign-in in your browser. Check that it shows the code %1$s, then come back here.
Sign in with the account you already use on your computer. Your master password and Secret Key never leave your devices.

Hold the camera over the code on your computer. Mosaic reads it on this device only.
